text: Enable agentic search through GitHub MCP. Requires agentic search access on the selected account.
Use staging for all built-in GitHub MCP tools. Requires DevVPN.
Enable MCP Tasks in local sessions. Turn off to test fallback tools.
Retain known change counts and throttle speculative Git work independently of foreground reads.
Give Mona a carved 3D pumpkin head that follows her body's monochrome rendering.
Download and run Windows ML models on this device.

Let Auto route turns to supported on-device models. Takes effect for sessions you start after turning this on. Local models may not use the same safety filters as GitHub Copilot-provided models and may be more susceptible to malicious instructions, especially when actions are automatically approved.
Read local workspace change counts without preparing full diff contents until the Changes panel is opened.
Enable Azure DevOps support. When Azure DevOps plugin activation is enabled, installing the featured plugin also enables support independently of this setting.
Automatically enable Azure DevOps support when the featured Azure DevOps plugin is installed.
Create, preview, and edit Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides stored in Google Drive. Currently in a limited preview: your Google account must be added to Google's allow-list before you can sign in.
Open supported canvases directly from the Canvas tab.
GitHub Enterprise Server support is experimental. Not all features work yet. Please send feedback to help us improve support.
Add a chevron to pull request fix buttons with a "Fix with instructions" option that prefills the composer instead of running immediately.
Start eligible worktree sessions from local refs while remote refs refresh in the background.
Stop the app from renaming existing sessions when a pull request is created or its title changes. Titles supplied by remote hosts such as copilotd still apply.
Show marketplace catalog status in Customize instead of as notifications.
Emphasize unread session names with bold text in the sidebar.
Create and name custom sidebar sections to keep related sessions together, alongside pinned sessions and automatic sections.
Let Projects subscribe to app and GitHub events and wake up when they happen. Subscriptions appear in the session side rail.
Issue and pull request unread indicators
Show unread indicators and filtering for issues and pull requests, with desktop notification delivery and automatic cleanup.

Turn on editing actions for issues and pull requests: edit titles and descriptions, edit, delete, and hide comments, and show an edited indicator. Every action applies to both issues and pull requests, in the detail and workspace views.
Show current pull request reviewers as status rows with explicit remove and re-request actions.
Show workflows waiting for maintainer approval and let repository writers approve them from pull request check panels.
Show the pull requests that close an issue and the issues that a pull request closes.
Rerun a conversation's transcript only when its own session changes, not when any other agent session receives an event.
Keep live resource update channels open when an older subscription finishes closing after a replacement subscribes.
Show a preview card with the repository, opened date, title, state, author, and branches when hovering a pull request link in a conversation or a pull request button on the Overview tab.
Open native Word, Excel, and PowerPoint canvases for Office artifacts, with structured viewing and editing backed by the in-app OOXML engine. Staff-only while in development.
Browse, create, and edit your GitHub gists in a built-in canvas, open it with /gists, and let the agent work with your gists.
Enable Office icebreakers, Create and Connectors menus, and OneDrive-backed Library entry points.
Create, view, and edit Office documents with rich, web-powered experiences. Currently supports Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Takes effect after restart.
Show byte-size deltas instead of line-count deltas for asset files in diff headers. Staff-only while asset previews are in development.
A read-only tour of the changes in a pull request.
Show Diff and Tour inside the pull request Files tab instead of a separate Tour tab.

Opening a PR's Tour automatically creates and uploads its first tour when none exists and you have repository write access. Everyone who can read the PR can reuse it. Source snapshots are not uploaded.
Edit a whole file directly from the All changes or Uncommitted changes diff.
Observe file watcher dispatch completion during shutdown and prevent replaced file subscriptions from publishing stale changes.
Reveal unchanged lines around a hunk in a pull request diff. Context is fetched from the PR's commit over the network, unlike workspace diffs which read a local checkout.
Add Find in Page (macOS and Windows), page zoom, and hard reload to the browser toolbar menu.

Render MCP App (SEP-1865) UI resources from connected MCP servers inline in the conversation. Apps can be opened in the side panel from the row, and a guest's fullscreen request opens the app in the side panel too. Takes effect after restart.
Use windowed rendering and in-place section editing for a responsive Markdown file editing experience.
Review plans in the real conversation composer instead of the one-line feedback field, with mentions, attachments, dictation, and references to specific plan text. Staff-only while in development.
Show runtime goal status and details in the composer and session utility rail.
Replace composer pills with a right-side rail for session resources, launchers, sources, side chats, schedules, artifacts, and background work.
Pause playing media while Voice dictation records and resume it afterward.

Hold the voice key (Ctrl+Shift+Space) to speak one command, or tap it to keep listening. Say a control on screen to press it, a command to run it, or an answer to the agent's prompt. Anything risky asks first.
Save completed agent responses as Markdown artifacts and open them in Files.
Legacy platform cache diagnostics. This flag does not enroll the local-first platform store.
Staff opt-in for the local-first platform store and checks Shadow comparison. Legacy reads and actions remain authoritative.
Show staff-only provenance and availability indicators for platform data.

Adds /impeccable, a frontend design and UI-craft skill by Paul Bakaus (impeccable.style), bundled under Apache-2.0. Its optional automation scripts need Node 18+ on your PATH; without Node the agent falls back to the design guidance alone.
Show one shared line-number column in the unified diff instead of separate old/new columns. Deleted rows show '-'.
Show fixed-height before and after previews for changed PNG, JPEG, and SVG files in local workspace diffs.
Open sessions in separate native windows for side-by-side multitasking.
Bring core GitHub views into the app so they can be deep-linked to and feel familiar to the web version.
Load the pull request record before prefetching metadata picker suggestions.
Opening a pull request panel joins compatible in-flight loading without invalidating its result.
Add a board layout to My Work that groups the current view's issues and pull requests into Backlog, Active, Needs attention, and Done columns derived from their state and linked session activity.
Create dashboards with configurable widgets for issues, pull requests, repository activity, and automations. Arrange and resize widgets in columns, and refine supported filters with Copilot.
Create freeform list and chart widgets with Copilot using connected data sources.
Let agents attach plans and artifacts to GitHub issues, surface them in the issue viewer, and auto-upload approved plans.
Allow Copilot to store and retrieve user preferences and repository facts in new and resumed sessions.
Keep local CLI alive while extensions are running
Prevent an idle local CLI from being reclaimed while one of its session extensions is still running.
Create and manage persistent projects that coordinate work across tasks.
Add a built-in GitHub agent under Projects that connects your repositories and services, looks around for work waiting on you, and starts other projects for bigger pieces of work.
Open the built-in GitHub agent immediately after authentication instead of continuing through repository, theme, and settings migration.
Show the GitHub agent's inbox as a pill in its composer that opens a one-at-a-time carousel, instead of the Inbox entry in its side rail.
Add a persistent chief of staff that tracks your work and helps you focus on what needs attention next.
Replace the right rail "+" menu's raw "Import canvas from gist/URL" and "Import canvas from repo" actions with task-oriented "Create a canvas" and "Discover more canvases" entries.
Let Copilot choose a model or combine work from multiple models for your task. Try HydraFusion instead of choosing a single model yourself. Research preview: experimental behavior may change.
Request v2 HydraFusion plans, which add per-phase reasoning effort, a wider model set, and subagents planned as the phase's model.
Report the committed HydraFusion root to CAPI so v2 plans can keep a conversation's root model across turns.
Use the Lexical-based rich-text editor for prompts, PR and issue comments, and issue creation.
Custom agents are added from the + menu and shown as a removable chip. /agent commands and automation editors are unchanged.
Enforce managed model options in new supported local sessions. Existing sessions retain their original enforcement until restarted.
Choose whether Auto optimizes for efficiency, balance, or intelligence.
Show Universe announcements in place of the other product-update campaigns.

Replace Auto with Copilot Fusion, whose effort levels come from the server. Turn off to keep Auto's static tiers and opt in to HydraFusion separately. Applies to new and resumed local sessions; cloud and remote sessions keep their tiers under the names Standard, High and Max.
Enable the decide tool for probabilities, classification, and scoring in local sessions. Staff experiments only. Do not send customer data.
Show the additional-usage budget as a quantified `X of Y AIC` figure in quota banners instead of qualitative copy. Off by default; falls back to the sentence copy when disabled.
Staff opt-in to warm a persistent cache for repository labels, milestones, and issue types while direct GitHub responses remain authoritative.
Serve repository labels, milestones, and issue types from the persistent cache using stale-while-revalidate.
Run app-managed sessions, including Agency sessions, on the native Rust runtime. JavaScript extensions keep their existing host. Requires a restart.

Refresh enterprise client compatibility in the background; require live admission only for previously managed accounts with stale or restricted evidence. Keep off until backend applicability is verified.
Use the git binary shipped with the app instead of the system-installed one. Falls back to your system git when off.
Discover WSL distributions and create sessions inside them.
Run sessions on your own machines over SSH or a direct connection.
Discover and connect to your Codespaces.
Register this machine as a Mission Control environment through this Copilot app. Access sessions created in this environment from another Copilot app while this app is open.
Run each top-level session in a new cloud environment.
Open search, then choose "Resume remote session".
Control local sessions from another device.
Carry the embedded terminal's PTY traffic over the app's WebSocket instead of Tauri IPC. Restart the app after toggling.
Disable TGrep for new runtime processes in the verified organization or enterprise cohort.

Enable Assisted mode, which approves requests an LLM safety check deems safe and prompts otherwise. When you turn off this experiment, existing Assisted sessions change to Ask every time (Off). Agent Merge sessions change to Approve all.
Remove the Experimental label from Assisted approvals.
Set Assisted as the default for new local sessions once. You can choose another default afterward in Settings > Sessions > Tool permissions. Existing sessions are unchanged.
Add personal guidance for how Assisted reviews tool calls in local sessions. Changes apply when a session starts.
Add personal guidance for how Agent Merge handles review feedback, CI failures, and conflicts.
Keep routine Agent merge and coordinated-session updates quiet in the sidebar and desktop notifications. Results and decisions that need you still request attention.
When Agent Merge is switched on for a workspace, move its session from Approve All to safe auto-approval instead of leaving it on Approve All.
Let agents read and change Agent merge for sessions they own, created, or coordinate.
Agents can turn on Agent merge auto-merge
Let agents ask to turn on Agent merge's Merge PR action. You still confirm each request in the app.
Control Computer Use preview availability without changing the user's saved preference.
Register the bundled Computer Use plugin so sessions can control local desktop apps.
Browse and connect Copilot Connectors under MCP in Customize. Enabling MCP includes connectors; each service requires an explicit connection and consent. Your organization's MCP controls still apply.
Offer Connectors based on session content
Offer relevant Connectors when session content requires an external service capability that available tools cannot provide.
Search for, add and manage MCP servers, Skills and plugins from GitHub in Customize.

Show Automation groups and standalone Automations together, open Automations in a dedicated detail view, and create and manage repository-bound cloud Automations. Turning this off saves your preference, but these features remain available while the rollout enables them for your account. Your preference takes effect when that rollout no longer enables them. Saved resources and cloud Automations are unchanged.
Show recent Copilot Dreaming runs for your added repositories and your account in a Dreaming tab in Automations. Controlled by ExP, not a user toggle.
Connect supported companion devices to navigate sessions, use voice input, and control integrations.
Combine the app header and Windows window controls in a single bar. Windows only.
Choose a logical model separately from the provider used to run it.
Show live session status as a Copilot agent icon and hover card on the Windows taskbar.
Validates ExP assignment delivery and attribution without changing product behavior.
